Performance marketing is not 'the ads look nice'. You pay for a click; the click has to land somewhere that sells. I spent 45 minutes on the zunsolar funnel this morning (14 Sep 2026). The business is strong - Godrej family office at 70%+, Rs.25.14 Cr raised in Sep 2025, $18M total, 40,000+ roofs, 75+ cities, Rs.60 Cr of customer bill savings. The funnel is not at that standard.

Live leaks:
1. zunroof.com now resolves to zunsolar.com, and the new page introduces itself as 'zunsolar (previously zunroof)' in nearly every line - including the WhatsApp prefill, which still says 'via zunroof.com'. Every paid click pays a rebrand tax.
2. The subsidy block says 'upto 40% solar subsidy on total installation cost'. PM Surya Ghar pays fixed slabs - Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000 by DBT, loans at 5.75%. That line is both wrong for 2026 and a dispute waiting to happen. 'Payback 3-4 years guaranteed' is the same problem.
3. Day-1 leak confirmed: static posters and stock images. Your own site names 17 kW Gurugram, 11 kW Delhi, 9 kW Zirakpur, 6 kW Amritsar customers - and not one roof video. The homepage YouTube embed returns 'Video unavailable'.

5. 75+ cities and zero city landing pages, despite HAREDA / PSPCL / TSREDCO / MNRE empanelment.
6. Press wall stops at 2021 ('160% growth in FY 2021') while the Godrej-backed story from Sep 2025 - the strongest trust asset you own - is nowhere in the creative.

3-page confidential audit, 3 fixes (rebrand + subsidy copy, calculator + city pages, 25 terrace Reels). Shall I WhatsApp it to 9205695690? One message, no call.
